blocks.h2: When to Replace Your Water Heater

tiles.body: Water from the tank body means it's rusting through.

tiles.h3: It's 10 to 12 Years Old or More
tiles.body: In hard water areas, plan ahead rather than wait for the leak.
When scale has hardened on the bottom, flushing stops helping and efficiency keeps dropping.
A bigger household or a new bathroom can outgrow the tank.

blocks.h2: Water Heater Installs in McHenry Homes
blocks.intro: Water heater replacement is one of the jobs McHenry County homeowners call us about most. Here's how we approach it.

items.body: With hard groundwater, the install is a chance to set the heater up for easy yearly flushing and to make sure any softener or [filtration system](/mchenry/water-filtration-systems) is working.
If your home is from those years and the heater has never been replaced, it's living on borrowed time. Replacing it before it fails protects a finished basement.
Tankless units need regular descaling in hard water, but they can be a great fit. See [tankless water heaters](/mchenry/tankless-water-heater).

blocks.h2: Water Heater Installation Questions From McHenry Homeowners

items.q: Should I get a water softener with my new water heater?
items.preview: If your water is hard, it helps the new heater last.
items.answer: If your water is hard, a softener reduces the scale that shortens a heater's life. A [water test](/mchenry/water-filtration-systems) tells you if it's worth it.

items.q: What size water heater do I need?
items.preview: Most families do well with 40 to 50 gallons.
items.answer: Most households of three or four do well with 40 or 50 gallons. Larger households or big tubs may need more capacity or faster recovery.

items.q: Can you replace it the same day?
items.answer: Often, yes. Standard tank heaters are usually in stock. Tankless and specialty units may take longer.

items.q: Do you serve homes outside McHenry city limits?
items.answer: Yes. Our West Elm Street office serves McHenry and nearby communities like Johnsburg, Wonder Lake, Ringwood and more.

items.q: How much does water heater installation cost in McHenry?
items.preview: It depends on type, size and code updates. You get a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the type and size of the heater, the venting and any code updates. We give you a flat-rate price before any work begins.
